eventDetail.scope: ICBAIE 2026 will serve as a high-level international academic forum focused on the innovation, integration, and interdisciplinary application of big data, AI, and IoT engineering technologies. The conference will convene global researchers, engineers, and industrial experts to share cutting-edge findings, tackle core technical challenges, and advance the deep integration of academic research and industrial practice. Its core research tracks will include: big data theory and algorithms, big data mining and analysis, big data storage and management, multi-source data fusion, machine learning and deep learning, natural language processing, explainable AI, intelligent robotics and computer vision, IoT architecture and protocols, wireless sensor networks, smart city and IoT applications, and edge intelligence for IoT. All aim to build a professional exchange platform, boosting technological innovation and industrial development in these interdisciplinary fields.
